issue: Chrome DevTools Application > WebMCP showed zero Available Tools in v2.2

sourceFindings.v2.2FalsePositiveStatus: The app displayed Career Buddy connected and used 33 as fallback count even when document.modelContext was unavailable.
sourceFindings.v2.2OriginIsolationHeaderMissing: The local server did not send Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?1.
sourceFindings.v2.2ToolsPolicyNotExplicit: The local server did not explicitly declare the tools Permissions Policy.
sourceFindings.v2.2NativeDiscoveryNotVerified: Tests mocked registerTool but did not compare registration with document.modelContext.getTools().
sourceFindings.staleServiceWorkerRisk: A previous service worker could serve stale HTML/JavaScript on localhost.

validation.actualChromeWebMCPPanel: Must be confirmed in a WebMCP-enabled Chrome build; this container does not expose that experimental panel/API.
